lines.en:
This is it...  The scriptures all lead to this place...  where it all began.
It is not moving...
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en:
Holy Donar...  hear me...  I have made the journey...  I bring to you the voices of your followers...  thousands of them...  hear us and hear our plea...
We have nothing left to give...
lines.name: 戴安娜
